DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia.

The clinical picture of a 26-year-old male presenting with a 6-week history of bizarre behavior, delusions of persecution/control by the NSA, auditory hallucinations commanding him to act, and decreased need for sleep is highly consistent with a first-episode psychosis. Given the duration and the specific nature of the symptoms (command hallucinations and paranoid delusions), the most likely diagnosis is schizophrenia. I will recommend starting antipsychotic medication and arranging for a psychiatric consultation for further management.
